resultados.refuerzo: A bank ban is a distractor; the question asks why she avoided investing.
Autónomo means self-employed: someone who works for themselves.
Changing subject is a distractor; the question asks what the teacher advised about memorising.
Speeding is a distractor; the question asks for the reason the text gives for the fine.
Ceda el paso means give way: the sign telling drivers to let others go first.
Chocar contra means to crash into, so contra is the right preposition.
Poner el intermitente means to indicate: switch on the turn signal before turning.
Un corresponsal is a correspondent, a journalist who reports from abroad.
Resignation is a distractor; the question asks what happens if no coalition forms.
Opposition government is a distractor; the question asks about new elections instead.
Late discovery is a distractor; the defence's argument concerns his past work there.
Ownership by a brother is a distractor; the defence argues about his past work.
Condenar a means to sentence to, so a is the right preposition.
Una coartada is an alibi: proof that you were somewhere else at the time.
The Constitution is a distractor; the problem is that rights are not always respected.
Too many laws is a distractor; the text's point is that written rights are not respected.
Existir is infinitive; el hecho de que needs a conjugated subjunctive, exista.
Advertising needs are a distractor; the market research pointed to very low demand.
A new partner is a distractor; the text names a famous actress as the turning point.
Rentable means profitable: a business that makes money.
Pinchar en means to click on, so en follows the verb.
Una copia de seguridad is a backup, a copy kept in case of disaster.
Same season is a distractor; scientists say both share the same cause, warmer air.
Authorship is a distractor; the mystery in the text is who is looking at whom.
Una estatua de mármol: de shows the material the statue is made of.
En marks a location; the material of a statue takes de.
Con means with; the material of a statue takes de.
Un retrato is a portrait, a painting of a person's face.
A publisher's request is a distractor; the question asks why they sent only half.
La librería means bookshop, not library, which is la biblioteca.
La banda sonora is the soundtrack, the music of a film.
Lack of a rehearsal place is a distractor; the problem was the cost of instruments.
Changing sport is a distractor; the coach's advice concerns retiring from competition.
Fashionable is a distractor; aficionado means amateur, not fashionable.
Barajar means to shuffle, the step before dealing the cards.
Apostar means to bet, which is not the step you take before dealing.
Being paid is a distractor; the question asks about tradition and belonging.
A tourist show is a distractor; the question asks what a procession means to people.
Un Estado laico is a state with no official religion: laico means secular.
The Earth stopping is a distractor; the question asks about the Sun's size and distance.
